description: §64.1 / §64.3 — a `kind="tool"` program compiles to a runnable module; `function main(args: string[]) -> number` is invoked with the argument slice (empty here) and its host I/O block writes stdout. The (b) half RUNS the module with `bun` and asserts its stdout byte-for-byte.
rationale: §64.3: "The emitted harness invokes `main(process.argv.slice(2))`. The RETURN-TYPE of `main` selects the harness arm"; §64.1: "It is runnable directly (`bun <emitted>.js <args…>`)"; §23.2.4 form 3 admits the bare `_{}` host-I/O block in a tool function.
